projects.title: Work that
projects.lede: Selected engineering and research work — the kind of project I couldn't write about honestly until I'd built it first. One thing done properly, rather than a grid of repositories nobody opens.

writing.heading: This is where the essays come from
writing.body: The reimplementations are what make the writing possible — you can't explain an architecture honestly until you've had to make it train.

oss.note: Everything here is open source — MIT unless the repository says otherwise.
